note: R274 collapsed a periodless chain and stranded a single 间 after its sentence, in nine chapters. The host sentence is the recycled 「空气像被这句话X」 filler, and in every case the paragraphs on both sides carry real content, so the whole line is deleted. Each chapter is re-checked against the 3000 floor.
